provenance.note: Derived by the DISTRICT cascade pipeline (neer-vazhvu-api/app/cascade, d8_steepest_descent_v1 over FABDEM; inputs_hash in _meta). Mumbai is reservoir-impounded, NOT tank-cascade geography - registered for the lake catchment atlas; the cascade overlay is suppressed when edge_count is negligible (see districts.py). Sentinel/OSM channel cross-checks are NotImplemented (P5) and the buildings/rainfall stages did not run for this district, so those upstreams are deliberately NOT listed. FABDEM input makes this family CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial) encumbered.
